  • Method Details

    • findAll

      public List<User> findAll() throws SQLException
      Reads every row in users where is_visible is true.
      Returns:
      the visible employees, ordered by last name, then first name
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • findByUsername

      public User findByUsername(String username) throws SQLException
      Looks up a user by exact username. Removed employees are not excluded, so a hidden user is still found.
      Parameters:
      username - username to match, case-sensitive
      Returns:
      the matching user, including the password hash, or empty if none matches
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • save

      public User save(String firstName, String lastName, String username, String role, String passwordHash) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new employee with all of their details at the default store.
      Parameters:
      firstName - first name
      lastName - last name
      username - login name, must be unique
      role - manager or cashier
      passwordHash - already-hashed password
      Returns:
      the inserted user as read back from the database, including its generated id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the insert fails (for example, the username is taken)

    • update

      public User update(User user) throws SQLException
      Updates the first name, last name, username and role of the row matching the user's id, and sets updated_at to now. Store and password hash are not written. Hidden rows are not excluded.
      Parameters:
      user - the user to save; its id selects the row
      Returns:
      the updated user as read back from the database
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails or no row has that id

    • deleteById

      public void deleteById(long id) throws SQLException
      Soft-deletes an employee by setting is_visible to false and updated_at to now. The row itself is kept in the database. Hiding an already hidden employee still succeeds.
      Parameters:
      id - user id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails or no row has that id

    • updateLastLogin

      public void updateLastLogin(long userID) throws SQLException
      Intended to set last_login_at to now. Not implemented yet: the query is never run, so this method currently does nothing.
      Parameters:
      userID - user id
      Throws:
      SQLException - never thrown in the current implementation
